## Checklist

- [ ] I kept exact, rejected, heuristic, and prediction records disjoint.
- [ ] I updated documentation and the changelog for public changes.
- [ ] I preserved existing serialized identities or introduced a new version.
- [ ] I ran the relevant format, lint, test, documentation, and artifact gates.
- [ ] I recorded null results, limitations, and unresolved validation gaps.
- [ ] Every commit includes a DCO sign-off (`git commit -s`).
